$comment: pi-httpproxy config. Copy to ~/.pi/proxy-domains.json and edit. Fields: proxy = HTTP proxy URL for whitelisted domains; domains = whitelist rules (exact, .base, or *.base; plain-text group labels are ignored); tapTelegramEnv = set PI_TELEGRAM_NETWORK_FAMILY=auto for pi-telegram (default true). PROXY_URL / PROXY_DOMAINS env vars override the file.
domains: -- Group labels (lines that don't look like domains) are ignored --
